methodology: Pins mark named project venues from council or venue-operator location data, matched to original grant notices. They are not recipient offices or postcode centres.
Published grants and invitations are separate views. A grant shared by several sites is counted once; its value is never assigned in full to each pin.

Locations are venue markers, not surveyed construction footprints. Electoral labels describe the venue point against the AEC boundaries used at the 2025 federal election. They are not a seat-level funding comparison.
The first checked locations are a selected sample, not representative of all funding. Records without a checked location remain available in the full list.
A published award records a grant agreement, not proof that money has been paid or work completed.
